_comment: RFC-0016 mock-DM deploy-smoke fixture. Seeded by the live DM (2026-07-04), reconciled to the real emit shape (fact_extractor's friendly <world_update>: top-level world/characters/locations + a top-level check_request) and the real two-round-trip cadence (a check_request turn, then its roll-resolve turn). Walks the Fantasy mechanics stack — stats/HP -> a skill check -> combat to 0 HP -> unconscious -> the 3-save death chain -> dead. Death is server-authoritative (engine.death_stakes force-writes the clock+status over the mock's narrative), so the harness drives the death_save rolls; the mock supplies narrative + the next check_request. PC = Kaelen, Warrior, Body 7 -> HP 56.

turns.narrative: The realm of Aerth opens before you, Kaelen — a stalwart Warrior, blade at your hip, the old forest road ahead. Ancient runes are carved into a mossy standing stone where the path forks.

characters.name: Kaelen
characters.description: A stalwart Warrior at the outset of the journey.

turns.player_action: I examine the ancient runes carved into the standing stone.
turns.narrative: You crouch to read the worn glyphs. The meaning hovers just out of reach — a name, a warning. Make sense of it.

check_request.label: Decipher the runes
check_request.prompt: Roll Mind to read the ancient warning.

turns.narrative: The glyphs resolve: 'Beyond lies the Gravemaw — turn back.' You do not. The left path darkens as you press on.

turns.player_action: I draw my sword and advance into the wood.
turns.narrative: Branches snap. A gaunt, long-limbed horror unfolds from the dark — the Gravemaw. It lunges. Strike!
Your blade bites deep — but the Gravemaw's claws rake across your chest in answer. It reels; so do you.
Steel and claw meet again. The horror shudders but will not fall, and its talons open you further.
You drive your blade home — the Gravemaw folds, but with its last strength it buries a claw in your side. You stagger, bleeding hard.

turns.player_action: I bind my wound and push on, deeper into the wood.
turns.narrative: You have not gone twenty paces when a second horror drops from the canopy. You are already bleeding, already spent — and it is on you.
Too slow. The horror's claws tear through your guard and open your throat-side. The world tilts; your sword falls from numb fingers. You drop to the leaf-mould and do not rise.
Cold spreads from the wound. You claw at consciousness — and slip. Darkness gains.
Your breath rattles, shallow and slowing. Somewhere far away the second horror circles. Hold on — if you can.
The dark closes over Kaelen for the last time. The forest keeps its silence. Here the journey ends.
